source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 20 May 1961, p. 7 ("Last-Minute Nomination at Glenmornan")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the members returned read in the Strabane Chronicle of 20 May 1961, p. 7, and the Glenmornan count in the News-Letter of 2 June 1961.

note: Triennial election of Strabane Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Glenmornan was the only division contested; the other 27 members were returned unopposed, making 20 Unionists and 8 Nationalists. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
